title: Christopher Nolan Says It Will Be ‘At Least’ Three Years Until He Makes Another Movie After ‘The Odyssey’ Pushed the ‘Limits of My Own Stamina’
content:
ByJack Dunn

Christopher Nolanrecently told “Today” that after giving it his all for “The Odyssey,” it will be “at least” three years until he makes another movie.

“I definitely hit the limits of my own stamina and everybody’s stamina, I think,” Nolan said. “I mean, it’s ‘The Odyssey,’ of course it should be difficult. We’re not doing the job right making a film of ‘The Odyssey’ if it doesn’t seem difficult.”

One of the many challenging facets of “The Odyssey” was that it was shot entirely with Imax cameras. Nolan recalled telling the team at Imax before shooting, “If ever we are going to fulfill this dream of shooting the entire movie that way, this is the one. This is ‘The Odyssey.’”

Even though “The Odyssey” proved to be agrueling production, Nolan would not have wanted it any other way. He recently told the New York Times that studiosneed to stop playing it safewith their blockbusters, because audiences are hungry “for something new.”

“If you’re really interested in movies and the history of movies, the one thing you see absolutely is that you have to take risks to succeed. The biggest risk of all is to play it safe,” Nolan said. “That’s what, consistently in mainstream movies, doesn’t work. The audience is looking for something new.”

“The Odyssey,” based on Homer’s ancient Greek epic, tells the story of Odysseus and his arduous journey back home after his victory in the Trojan War. Matt Damon stars as Odysseus, leading an all-star cast of Tom Holland, Zendaya, Anne Hathaway, Lupita Nyong’o, Robert Pattinson, Charlize Theron and more.
title_zh: 克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)表示，在《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)之後，他至少需要三年時間才能再拍攝另一部電影，因為這部電影挑戰了他自身的耐力極限。
content_zh:
由Jack Dunn報導

克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)最近在《今日》(Today)節目中表示，在全力以赴拍攝《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)後，他將至少需要三年時間才能再拍一部電影。

“我確實達到了自己和大家的耐力極限，我想，”諾蘭說。“我的意思是，這是《奧德賽》，當然應該是困難的。如果拍攝《奧德賽》的過程不顯得困難，那我們就沒有做好這部電影。”

《奧德賽》的一個挑戰性方面是它完全使用IMAX攝影機拍攝。諾蘭回憶起在拍攝前告訴IMAX團隊的話：“如果我們真的要實現用這種方式拍攝整部電影的夢想，那麼這部電影就是了。這就是《奧德賽}。” 

儘管《奧德賽》的製作過程十分艱辛，諾蘭卻不會想要以其他方式進行。他最近告訴《紐約時報》(New York Times)，製片廠需要停止在其大片中玩得太安全，因為觀眾渴望“新鮮事物”。

“如果你真的對電影和電影歷史感興趣，你會發現一件事，那就是必須冒險才能成功。最大的風險就是玩得太安全，”諾蘭說。“這在主流電影中一貫是不奏效的。觀眾在尋找新鮮事物。”

《奧德賽》改編自荷馬的古希臘史詩，講述了奧德修斯在特洛伊戰爭勝利後艱難回家的旅程。馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)飾演奧德修斯，並領銜包括湯姆·霍蘭德(Tom Holland)、辛迪亞(Zendaya)、安妮·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)、露皮塔·尼永奧(Lupita Nyong’o)、羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)、查理茲·塞隆(Charlize Theron)等全明星陣容。
